label: Get your WhatsApp API account information
description: <Note>You can use this API for WhatsApp only if you have setup your WhatsApp account on Brevo platform. To setup your WhatsApp account, follow the steps in the guide below. [Activating WhatsApp](https://developers.brevo.com/docs/whatsapp-campaigns-1) in your account</Note>

businessStatus.description: Verification status information of the Business account

phoneNumberNameStatus.description: Status of the name associated with WhatsApp Phone number

phoneNumberQuality.description: Quality status of phone number associated with WhatsApp account. There are three quality ratings. example - **High (GREEN) , Medium (YELLOW) and Low(RED)**

sendingLimit.description: Sending limit of the WhatsApp account

whatsappBusinessAccountId.description: Id of the WhatsApp business account

whatsappBusinessAccountStatus.description: Status information related to WhatsApp Api account

preconditions: WhatsApp Business account connected (needed before any call in this area)
